Item.value: Generic unidirectional HS (High Strength) grade Carbon Fibre Reinforced Epoxy Composite.
These are values for a randomly orientated, chopped carbon fibre epoxy moulding compound with 55% fibre volume fraction. The properties are near isotropic.

Property.name: Materials
Property.doc: List of materials used (autofills from Materials in Analysis object)

Property.name: Orientations
Property.doc: List of ply orientations (in-plane angles in degrees)

Property.name: Thicknesses
Property.doc: List of ply thicknesses (thicknesses in mm)

Property.name: Windall
Property.doc: Dictionary of elements and layups resulting from filament winding analysis

Property.name: CharacteristicLengthMax
Property.doc: Max mesh element size (0.0 means infinity)

Property.name: ElementDimension
Property.doc: Dimension of mesh elements ('From Shape': according ShapeType of part to mesh)

Property.name: GroupsOfNodes
Property.doc: For each group create not only the elements but the nodes too

Property.name: MeshSizeFromCurvature
Property.doc: Number of elements per 2*pi radians, 0 to deactivate

Property.name: OptimizeNetgen
Property.doc: Optimize tetra elements by use of Netgen

Property.name: Recombine3DAll
Property.doc: Apply recombination algorithm to all volumes

Property.name: RecombineAll
Property.doc: Apply recombination algorithm to all surfaces

Property.name: SecondOrderLinear
Property.doc: Second order nodes are created by linear interpolation

Property.name: SolverPrecision
Property.doc: Precision of solver (a smaller number will quite with an error if this accuracy can't be met)

Property.name: MassFlowRate
Property.doc: List of mass flow rate values

Property.name: MaxShear
Property.doc: List of Maximum Shear stress values

Property.name: MohrCoulomb
Property.doc: List of Mohr Coulomb stress values

Property.name: Peeq
Property.doc: List of equivalent plastic strain values

Property.name: vonMises
Property.doc: List of von Mises equivalent stresses
